On Sat, Jun 7, 2025 at 9:12 AM Tom Geller <tom@saasify.com> wrote:
> Thanks for taking this — attaching our standard MSA and a filled Order Form to start the intake.

Hi all — quick first-pass notes after a short read-through:
- Liability / cap: SaaSify's MSA currently includes a broad unlimited liability carveout in Exhibit B; propose we cap to 3x fees for commercial breach and standard carveouts for data/privacy incidents.
- Data residency / security: Order Form lists "us-west" but no DPA attachment. Ask SaaSify for SOC 2 report or DPA preferences.
- SLA / credits: Order Form SLA language is sparse; recommend adding clear uptime SLA and credit calculation.
- IP / indemnity: propose minor wording tweaks to limit assignment of customer-created IP.

I'll prepare an annotated redline (Redlines_MSA_SaaSify_20250608.docx) with line-level comments and a short summary doc. If procurement confirms the signatory and billing details today, I can aim to return redlines by Tue 10 Jun EOD.

Marissa
